environment.description: Celery worker deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN, container runs as non-root uid 10001, /tmp mounted as emptyDir with medium: Memory and sizeLimit 64Mi scoped per-pod (not shared), and the pod spec includes a seccomp profile of type RuntimeDefault. Additionally, the container filesystem is set to readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with only the per-pod tmpfs /tmp writable.
